# Ahnoud Tech

> Ahnoud Tech is a design and engineering studio in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, founded in 2024. Its in-house team, Kinomad Studio, covers design and engineering under one roof, so the brand and the build are carried by the same studio from identity to operations.

- Languages: English and Arabic
- Works with clients worldwide

## Team

- [Kinomad Studio](https://kinomadstudio.com): brand identity, web design, 3D visualization & animation, web development, AI agents & automation, application DevOps

## Purpose

To give ambitious companies a brand and the systems behind it, designed and built as one, so what they launch looks right, works right, and keeps running.

## Services

- [Brand Identity](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): naming, strategy, logo and identity systems, and brand guidelines
- [Web Design](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): websites and product interfaces, designed for clarity and conversion
- [3D Visualization & Animation](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): product renders, spatial visuals, and motion for launches and campaigns
- [Web Development](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): fast, accessible websites and web apps, built to scale
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): custom AI agents and automated workflows that take repetitive work off your team
- [Application DevOps](https://ahnoudtech.com/#services): deployment, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and care after launch
